scenes.title: 07-p6
lines: We test whether the visible surface point lies inside that region. The stencil buffer stores test values at image locations. If a point is in shadow, that light’s contribution is omitted; this is not simply a black image pasted onto the scene.

scenes.title: 09-p9
lines: A filter’s extent controls the neighborhood combined. PCSS adjusts it using the relationship between blockers and receivers. Variance shadow maps store depth’s first and second moments to approximate visibility. These are different approximations, with limitations such as light leaking in the latter.

scenes.title: g29
lines: Think of these points as locations storing lighting information, not little light sources. A wall texture stays on a surface; these samples occupy volume, including height. A moving character uses nearby information. Interpolation combines values between samples to avoid abrupt changes. This Unreal example is a different engine from Half-Life 2.
